explanation: At D1 it is near the top: 10 while the agent has been choosing a2, and 8-9 while it has been choosing a1 or early in the episode (before about trial 30). At GO it is 8-9 if the previous trial was rewarded and drops to 3-6 if it was not, falling lower after several losses in a row (a2 choices drop less, to about 6-8, on a single loss), while at D2 it is low: 0-1 when S2 is reached, 1-3 when S1 is reached after a1, and 3-7 when S1 is reached rarely after a2 (highest after repeated unrewarded trials).
